title: SDET-I
description:
**SDET-I — Quality Engineering**

**Engineering · Platform Quality Engineering**

Noida · 5 days WFO Full-Time · 2–3 Years

**Hiring Drive · 31 October 2026** · On-site assessment and panel in a single day.

*The team you're joining ships code that engineering teams at Wells Fargo, JPMorgan, Meta, Louis Vuitton, and Sephora run their tests through.*

The QA tooling you build here isn't internal. It's the product.

That's not a stepping stone to a dev job. It's a career most engineers never get to have.

**READ THIS FIRST**

Three honest filters, because we'd rather tell you now than at the offer stage.

* If you're planning to use QA as a route into a dev role within the next 12 months — this isn't it. We invest heavily in people who want to own Quality Engineering as a long career, not a stepping stone. Dev-switch intent is a kind thing to flag early; we'll help you find a role that fits better.
* If your QA experience has been running scripted test cases on behalf of someone else's product at a services company — this role will be harder than you expect. We hire from product companies because the muscle is different: owning quality for your own company's product shapes the way you think.
* **If you're excited about building test automation that becomes open-source tooling thousands of engineers rely on — keep reading.**

**THE MISSION**

We aren't automating scripts — we're deprecating the era of manual-heavy testing entirely. TestMu AI is building the world's first AI-native platform where Agentic Intelligence autonomously plans, authors, and self-heals the entire Quality Engineering lifecycle.

The name "TestMu" comes from our community conference — our users and our team are the heartbeat of what we build, not an audience.

You're joining the Quality Engineering team that keeps the platform itself honest. You'll write the tests that catch bugs before customers do, build the frameworks the rest of engineering ships with, and over time, own a slice of the product end-to-end. The QA craft, done the way it should be done.

**THE PILLARS OF IMPACT**

**Product QE Ownership (50%)**

* Own test automation for a core product surface — write robust, maintainable tests that catch regressions before they ship.
* Debug the hard bugs. Not just the ones that fail CI — the ones that fail at 3am in production for a customer in Austin.
* Raise the quality bar for your surface quarter over quarter. Flakiness goes down. Coverage goes up. Confidence to ship goes up.
* Partner with engineers, product, and support to make quality a shared discipline — not a team QA inherits at the end.

**Platform & Tooling Craft (30%)**

* Contribute to the internal QE frameworks the rest of engineering runs against. The code you write here is used by every team shipping product.
* Participate in our open-source work on Selenium and APM tooling. We're one of the few companies in India where "my pull request got merged into Selenium core" is a real line on your résumé.
* Build repeatable patterns — reusable fixtures, test harnesses, CI integrations — so quality compounds, not gets rewritten every quarter.

**Learning & Growth (20%)**

* Soak the product deeply. The best SDETs know what the product does better than most PMs. That's the bar.
* Get trained on the AI-native tooling we're building for the next generation of QE. You don't need to come in knowing LLMs — you need to come in curious and ready to learn.
* Grow into the next role. We hire SDET-I expecting you'll be SDET-II in 18 months, Senior in 3 years, and QA Lead or Manager QE after that — if you want it.

**WHY THIS SEAT, RIGHT NOW**

*The real differentiators.*

* Open-source credibility. We actively contribute to Selenium core and maintain APM tooling used by thousands of engineering teams around the world. Your work ships further than any product company you've worked at before.
* A product-first QE org. QA isn't an afterthought here. The platform we sell IS a quality engineering platform. Your craft is the company's core product.
* A clear growth path, promoted on merit. You'll see the full ladder on day one. Nobody at TestMu AI gets promoted on tenure — only on the work.
* Real training in AI-native QE. We're deploying Agentic Intelligence into our own QE lifecycle. The agents you learn to work with internally are the same agents our customers buy.

**THE AI YOU'LL BE TRAINED ON**

**You do not need to come in knowing LLMs. You need to come in curious.**

Over your first six months, you'll be trained on Claude, LLM-powered test generation, and the agentic workflows we're building into the platform itself. Our target is to agent away the repetitive parts of QE work — flaky-test triage, regression suite grooming, bug reproduction — so you spend your time on the hard, interesting problems that need an engineer's judgment.

*The AI tooling is a multiplier for a solid QE foundation, not a replacement for it. If your QA fundamentals are strong, the AI side we'll teach you.*

**THE BAR**

**Signal: What you'll show us.**

* QA fundamentals. You've written automated tests that actually caught bugs. You can tell us what makes a test flaky — and how you'd fix it.
* Product-company lens. You've worked on a product your own company sells to customers. You've felt the weight of a customer bug, not just a ticket in someone else's backlog.
* Career commitment to QE. You see Quality Engineering as a craft worth 10 years, not a stepping stone to Software Development Engineer. You can articulate why QE matters, and why you want to own it.
* **Extreme Ownership: Takes full accountability for outcomes, not just tasks.**

**YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS**

*Structured. Specific. Honest about the ramp.*

Days 1–30 — Soak.

* Deep onboarding on the product, the QE framework, and the open-source projects we contribute to.
* Shadow senior SDETs on real tickets. Learn how we debug, how we write tests, how we review PRs.
* Set up your dev environment, make your first (small) code contribution to the QE framework, raise your first bug.

Days 30–90 — Own.

* Pick up a core product surface. Own its test automation under senior guidance.
* Ship your first meaningful PR to one of our open-source dependencies — guided and reviewed.
* Begin training on AI-native QE workflows and start applying them in your day-to-day.
* Earn trust that lets you work with less oversight by day 90.

**YOUR PATH**

SDET-I SDET-II Senior SDET QA Lead Manager QE.

That's the ladder, written out so there's no guesswork. You move when the work moves — not when the calendar moves. Our best SDET-Is are SDET-IIs within 18 months. The ones who want to lead become QA Leads in 3–4 years. The end destination, if you want it, is owning the Quality Engineering function.

**Click it. Be amazed. testmuai-growth-path-beige.vercel.app/#/sdet-ii**

title: Senior Unix/Linux Automation Engineer
description:
**Position Overview:**  
  
Infrastructure Operations & Engineering team is seeking a Senior Unix Expert to join our global Unix Team, supporting India-hours coverage for a team that hosts critical applications, including Oracle-based Retail Management Systems (RMS).  
  
This is a senior-level individual contributor role requiring strong hands-on experience with a multi-platform enterprise environment spanning Oracle Linux (OL7/OL8/OL9) and AIX systems and automation-oriented development.  
  
The ideal candidate will be able to independently troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues, identify automation opportunities, plan and implement automation efforts, drive technical work through completion, and collaborate across infrastructure, security, cloud, database, network, storage, and application teams.

### **Key Responsiblities:**

Unix Server & Infrastructure Engineering (30%)

* Administer, patch, and maintain Oracle Linux and AIX servers; manage lifecycle and compliance using tools like OS Management Hub, Tanium, or equivalent.
* Manage virtual machine provisioning, migration, lifecycle, and decommissioning across Nutanix AHV and GCP.
* Support server standards, provisioning processes, infrastructure upgrades, migrations, and modernization initiatives.
* Troubleshoot complex server and infrastructure issues, perform root cause analysis, and drive corrective actions.
* Diagnose system memory, disk I/O, and storage performance issues (e.g., Virtual SCSI tuning) in high-availability environments.
* Coordinate with application, database, network, storage, cloud, and security teams to resolve cross-platform issues.

Processes automation (30%)

* Design, build, and maintain Ansible playbooks to manage configuration across heterogeneous Linux/AIX fleets.
* Lead discovery, planning, and implementation phases of new automation initiatives to reduce manual operations.

Security & Patch Management (25%)

* Support Linux and AIX Server patching using Tanium and related enterprise tools.
* Remediate vulnerabilities and security findings within defined SLAs.
* Support infrastructure security tools such as CrowdStrike and Delinea Secret Server.
* Prepare and execute production infrastructure changes following established change management processes.

Operational Support (15%)

* Take ownership of incidents and escalations through diagnosis, coordination, resolution, and documentation.
* Support monitoring and observability using platforms such as Datadog.
* Manage ITSM tickets and engineering work through Jira Service Management.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and operational procedures.
* Participate in disaster recovery testing, maintenance windows, and on-call support.

### **Basic Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience supporting Linux OS (Oracle Linux preferred) in enterprise/production environments.
* 4+ years of experience using Ansible for configuration management across Linux and AIX servers.
* Working knowledge of patch management tools and zero-downtime patching strategies.
* Proven experience driving automation projects from discovery through implementation.

* Strong Ansible playbook scripting and automation skills.
* Experience with Active Directory SSSD integration troubleshooting.
* Experience with Nutanix AHV.
* Experience with enterprise patch management and vulnerability remediation.
* Experience with ITSM and production change management processes.
* Ability to independently manage complex technical work with limited supervision.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Ability to participate in on-call support and after-hours maintenance when required.

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with Tanium, CrowdStrike, Delinea Secret Server, and/or Datadog.
* Experience supporting Linux workloads in GCP and/or AWS.
* Experience with certificate management (creation/update).
* Familiarity with FreeRADIUS, LDAP, or Kerberos.
* Familiarity with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
* Exposure to CI/CD and infrastructure automation platforms such as GitHub Actions or Jenkins.
* Experience with infrastructure migrations, cloud initiatives, or data center modernization.
* Relevant Linux, cloud, virtualization, or infrastructure certifications.

*We are proud to offer a competitive salary alongside a strong insurance package. We pride ourselves on the growth of our employees, offering extensive learning and development resources. This role is for on-site joining from our Noida office location.*

title: Systems Integration Specialist Advisor
description:
**Req ID:** 393282
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Systems Integration Specialist Advisor to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
The role requires strong expertise in API testing, automation framework architecture, microservices validation, integration testing, service virtualization, performance, security, and AI-enabled Quality Engineering.
  
  
This is a senior customer-facing technical role responsible for assessing API landscapes, defining testing solutions, building reusable automation approaches, and guiding QA teams through implementation.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* Own the end-to-end API testing architecture and solutioning strategy across enterprise applications.
* Understand business and technical architecture and translate it into a comprehensive API Quality Engineering strategy.
* Define API testing approaches covering functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, negative, security, performance, and resiliency testing.
* Design scalable and reusable API automation frameworks for REST, SOAP, GraphQL, and microservices.
* Define automation solutions using tools/frameworks such as REST Assured, Karate, Postman/Newman, Python/PyTest, Java, ReadyAPI/SoapUI, or equivalent.
* Architect testing solutions for complex microservices and distributed API ecosystems.
* Define API validation strategies across UI → API → Microservices → Database → Downstream systems.
* Establish contract testing strategies using tools such as Pact and consumer/provider contract validation.
* Define testing approaches for synchronous and asynchronous APIs, including Kafka/event-driven architectures and messaging systems.
* Design service virtualization/mocking solutions where dependent APIs or downstream systems are unavailable.
* Define API test data management and synthetic data generation approaches.
* Establish API automation integration with CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing and quality gates.
* Define API performance and scalability testing approaches using tools such as JMeter, Gatling, K6, or equivalent.
* Establish API security validation covering authentication, authorization, OAuth 2.0, JWT, API keys, data protection, and common API vulnerabilities.
* Define automation coverage, quality metrics, defect prevention strategies, and release-readiness criteria.
* Review existing QA frameworks and recommend modernization and automation improvements.
* Identify opportunities to use AI/GenAI in API testing, including test scenario generation, test data generation, automation script generation, defect analysis, and test optimization.
* Conduct PoCs and evaluate new QE tools, automation frameworks, and AI-assisted testing solutions.
* Lead technical discussions, solution walkthroughs, architecture reviews, and presentations with customers.
* Mentor QA Leads, SDETs, Automation Engineers, and API Testing teams.

API Solutioning Responsibilities
  
  
The candidate should be capable of independently assessing a customer API landscape and developing a complete testing solution:
  
  
Requirement Analysis → API Landscape Assessment → Risk Identification → Test Strategy → Automation Architecture → Tool Selection → PoC → Implementation → CI/CD Integration → Metrics Continuous Improvement
  
  
**The candidate should be able to answer questions such as:**  

* How should APIs across hundreds of microservices be tested efficiently?
* What should be automated at the API layer versus UI/E2E layer?
* How can API regression execution time be reduced?
* How should dependencies on unavailable downstream services be handled?
* How can contract testing prevent integration defects?
* How should asynchronous APIs and Kafka events be validated?
* How can API automation be integrated into CI/CD quality gates?
* How can AI improve API test design, automation, execution, and defect analysis?

Required Technical Skills
  
  
**Strong hands-on experience with:**  
API Testing Automation
  

* REST API and SOAP Web Services
* REST Assured
* Postman/Newman
* Karate
* SoapUI/ReadyAPI
* Python/PyTest
* Java/TestNG/JUnit
* JSON/XML validation
* OpenAPI/Swagger

API Integration Architecture
  

* REST/SOAP/GraphQL
* Microservices architecture
* API Gateway/API Management
* Kafka/Event-driven architecture
* Messaging systems
* API contracts and schema validation
* Database/backend validation

Advanced Testing
  

* Contract Testing
* Service Virtualization/Mocking
* API Performance Testing
* API Security Testing
* Integration Testing
* Resiliency/Failure Testing
* Test Data Management

DevOps Cloud
  

* Jenkins/Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions
* CI/CD and Continuous Testing
* Docker/Kubernetes fundamentals
* Azure/AWS/GCP exposure
* Git and source-code management

AI-Assisted Quality Engineering
  

* GenAI/LLM-assisted test generation
* AI-assisted automation development
* Intelligent test selection
* Synthetic test-data generation
* Defect/root-cause analysis
* GitHub Copilot or equivalent AI coding assistants

Architecture Leadership Expectations
  

* Strong experience designing enterprise API automation frameworks from scratch.
* Ability to assess an existing testing ecosystem and propose a target-state QE architecture.
* Strong understanding of automation framework design, reusable components, maintainability, and scalability.
* Ability to conduct technical PoCs and tool/framework evaluations.
* Ability to estimate automation effort, resource requirements, timelines, and implementation roadmap.
* Strong customer-facing communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to explain technical solutions to both engineering teams and senior stakeholders.
* Experience leading multiple QA/Automation teams and providing technical governance.

Experience
  

* 8+ years of overall Quality Engineering/Testing experience.
* 5+ years of strong API testing and automation experience.
* Demonstrated experience in API Test Architecture / Automation Architecture / QE Solutioning.
* Experience leading enterprise-level API testing and automation initiatives.
* Experience working directly with customers on QA transformation, solutioning, architecture, and implementation.

Ideal Candidate Profile
  
  
The candidate should be able to demonstrate at least 2–3 large API testing solutions personally architected and implemented, explaining:
